This indicates that Osugacestat can influence A2780cisR through different molecular mechanisms, each involving distinct upstream targets.

The integration of these pathways suggests that Osugacestat may exert its effects on A2780cisR through multiple, possibly overlapping, molecular mechanisms, highlighting the complexity of its interaction with the cell's regulatory networks.
